<?php
declare(strict_types=1);
$integer = new class {
    public function __get(int|string $incoming): int {
        if ($incoming === "bad") {
            echo "ENTER;";
            return true;
        }
        echo $incoming === "12" ? "NAME;" : "BAD_NAME;";
        $incoming = false;
        return 7;
    }
};
$floating = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): float { return 9; }
};
$boolean = new class {
    public function __get(mixed $incoming): bool { return true; }
};
$string = new class {
    public function __get(string $incoming): string { return "kept"; }
};
$mixed = new class {
    public function __get(?string $incoming): mixed { return null; }
};
$selector = "12";
echo $integer->$selector === 7 ? "INT;" : "BAD_INT;";
echo $floating->value === 9.0 ? "FLOAT;" : "BAD_FLOAT;";
echo $boolean->value === true ? "BOOL;" : "BAD_BOOL;";
echo $string->value;
echo ";";
echo $mixed->value === null ? "MIXED;" : "BAD_MIXED;";
$destination = 42;
try {
    $destination = $integer->bad === 7;
} catch (TypeError $failure) {
    echo "TYPE;";
}
echo $destination === 42 ? "KEEP;" : "BAD_STORE;";
echo $selector === "12" ? "NAME_KEEP;" : "BAD_SELECTOR;";
echo "DONE;";
